# Raylib 5.5

`include/raylib.h` and `lib/libraylib.a` are the existing Windows x64 Raylib 5.5
build available on this machine. The static library is linked by build.ps1.
Upstream: https://github.com/raysan5/raylib/tree/5.5
License: zlib/libpng; see LICENSE. No audio device is initialized by this game.
